items.title: Bring a Friend Only You Know
description: Bring a friend to the party that no-one else but you knows

items.title: Birthday-themed
description: Run on a date that is not your birthday
Guests wear party hats
Cake w/ candles
Goodie bags when leaving

items.title: I Couldn't Wear This Anywhere Else
description: Guests wear outfits they couldn't wear anywhere else
Arrive in normal clothes & change into their outfit on arrival
Examples include weird outfits, new styles, something they could only wear once

items.title: School Picture Day
description: Marbled backdrop
Photography lights
Everyone lines up and gets their photo taken
Group photo
Photos printed and given to guests

items.title: Victorian Banquet
description: Everyone dresses up in victorian-style clothes
Multi-course dinner at a big table
Everyone has to follow 'formal' eating etiquette

items.title: I Wore This All The Way Here
description: Guests come to party in stupid outfits
They have to wear it the whole way there
Guests vote on the silliest outfit

items.title: Among Us IRL
description: Guests are given secret roles
Crewmates must complete tasks
Impostors must sabotage & kill players

items.title: Secret Allergy
description: Every guest given random silly allergy
Examples include cold water, soft drinks, Any green food
Guests must guess eachothers' allergy
If your allergy is guessed, you lose

items.title: Wake-themed
description: Everyone wears funeral clothes
Coffee, tea, biscuits and sandwiches cut into triangles
Mournful, quiet chatting only

items.title: Murder Mystery
description: You already know what this is.

items.title: PowerPoint Night
description: Everyone creates a PowerPoint
Every guest gets only 3 minutes to present

items.title: Spy Party
description: Some guest is selected as the spy
Another as the double-agent
Another as the target
Last one as the Investigator
Spy must find the double-agent with a code word, plant evidence on the target and complete tasks without being identified

items.title: Ball Pit
description: One or more rooms have a ballpit
Normal party, just with a ballpit

items.title: Cocktail Making
description: Guests work together to make cocktails
Guests bring drinks & mixers
Cocktails tasted and ranked

items.title: Working From Home
description: Guests bring their laptops
All work from home together at the party

items.title: Year in Review
description: Guests prepare a PowerPoint
Covers everything they did this year
Keeps everyone up-to-date

items.title: Face Painting
description: Buy face paints
Hire a face painter / have everyone paint eachothers' faces

items.title: Clothes Pegging
description: Guests have to secretly plant as many clothes pegs on eachother as possible

items.title: Leaving Cert
description: Guests sit Leaving Cert exams (Bonus points for making a fake paper)
Grade eachothers papers
Highest grade wins a prize

items.title: Buzzball Thrower
description: Guests throw a BuzzBall at others
If the person catches it, they have to drink it
Otherwise, the thrower drinks it

items.title: Clownery
description: Normal party
Hire a clown, mime / immitator

items.title: Temporary Tattoos
description: Everyone attending has to put on at least one temporary tattoo
Normal party otherwise

items.title: Special interest quiz
description: Host makes a quiz of topics they enjoy
Guests compete in the quiz

items.title: Social Distance Kitchen
description: Guests work together to cook meals
Guests must use grabbers to cook

items.title: Just Sweet
description: Guests take the pill that make sour things taste sweet
All snacks at party are sour
Bonus point if some of the pills are placebo & guests have to guess who has a placebo

items.title: Chicken Rush
description: Someone wears a chicken costume
Guests must go through a city / town and find the bar with the chicken in it

items.title: Vampire Party
description: Everyone dresses as vampires
One guest is given the vampire role
Vampire must turn everyone by the end of the party

items.title: LAN Party
description: Guests bring laptops & PCs
Spend the day playing LAN games together

items.title: Spelling Bee
description: Like US Spelling Bees
Words get harder as time goes on

items.title: Show and Tell
description: Guests bring interesting items
Guests then show their item
Vote on most interesting item

items.title: Strapped
description: Guests bring their own drink
They have to wesr all of it
Nothing can be put down
